alerts.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 13 at 9:02PM MDT until October 14 at 6:00PM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected above 10000 feet. Total snow accumulations up
to 6 inches. Winds gusting as high as 35 mph.

* WHERE...Northwest San Juan Mountains and Southwest San Juan
Mountains.

* WHEN...From 6 AM to 6 PM MDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could become slippery at times due to slushy
conditions over mountain passes.
alerts.areaDesc: Northwestern San Juan Mountains; Southwest San Juan Mountains

alerts.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 13 at 9:02PM MDT until October 15 at 6:00AM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected above 9500 feet. Total snow accumulations
between 4 and 8 inches. Winds gusting as high as 35 mph.

* WHERE...Elkhead and Park Mountains, Flat Tops, Gore and Elk
Mountains/Central Mountain Valleys, Grand and Battlement Mesas, and
West Elk and Sawatch Mountains.

* WHEN...From 6 AM Wednesday to 6 AM MDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could become slippery at times due to slushy
conditions over mountain passes.
alerts.areaDesc: Elkhead and Park Mountains; Grand and Battlement Mesas; Gore and Elk Mountains/Central Mountain Valleys; West Elk and Sawatch Mountains; Flat Tops

alerts.title: I-70 Glenwood Canyon Bridge Joint Improvements-148522
alerts.description: Between Exit 129: Bair Ranch (6 miles west of the Dotsero area) and Exit 125: Hanging Lake (5 miles east of the No Name area) from Mile Point 126 to Mile Point 125. Right lane closed due to bridge construction. Starting October 14, 2026 at 7:00AM MDT until October 14, 2026 at about 7:00PM MDT. Full schedule below: • October 14, 7:00AM - October 14, 7:00PM Comment: Eastbound and westbound lane width restrictions, for commercial and recreational vehicles, are in effect 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. A commercial and recreational vehicle width limit of 11'-0" is in place for the duration of the project. Eastbound I-70 will be reduced to one lane from Mile Point 127 to 128. Westbound from Mile Point 125 to 126 on the east side of Hanging Lake Tunnel will be one-lane for bridge joint water testing. Daytime work hours will be 7 a.m. to 7 p.m., Monday through Friday. The speed limit will be reduced to 35 mph through the work zone.
